title: Crida For Drought Adaptation In The Limarí Watershed, Chile
summary: Application of the CRIDA methodology to improve drought resilience and water management in the Limarí basin under long-term climate uncertainty.
context: The basin faces declining water availability, low reservoir levels and increasing agricultural demand due to climate change and population growth.
actions: Stress-testing water systems, stakeholder-driven vulnerability assessment, and development of adaptation pathways combining infrastructure and management strategies.
outcomes: Identified robust adaptation strategies and supported integration into planning and policy.

title: Comprehensive Resilience Building in the Chimanimani District of Zimbabwe
summary: CRIDA-based resilience program addressing cyclones, floods and droughts through integrated water management and nature-based solutions.
context: Region affected by Cyclone Idai and recurrent disasters impacting livelihoods and water systems.
actions: Climate stress testing, vulnerability assessment and co-design of adaptation measures including check dams and ecosystem restoration.
outcomes: Improved resilience planning and stakeholder-supported adaptation strategies.

title: Resilient Water and Energy Supply for Zambia’s Capital in the Face of Drought
summary: Assessment of Lusaka’s water supply vulnerability to drought and energy constraints using CRIDA.
context: Water supply highly dependent on hydropower under climate stress.
actions: Stress testing system performance and comparing adaptation options including backup energy and storage.
outcomes: Identified cost-effective solutions improving resilience without overinvestment.

title: Climate Change Adaptation for Municipal Water Supply in Colombo, Sri Lanka
summary: Evaluation of climate risks to Colombo’s water supply system and development of adaptation strategies.
context: Water supply depends on the Kelani River under uncertain hydrological conditions.
actions: Demand-supply analysis and stress testing for climate variability.
outcomes: Prioritized demand management and resilience-focused planning.

title: Towards Climate-Resilient Urban Water Supply in Bangkok, Thailand
summary: Application of CRIDA to evaluate Bangkok’s water supply under uncertain climate futures.
context: Urban water system exposed to salinity, turbidity and flow variability.
actions: Scenario analysis and vulnerability stress testing.
outcomes: Identification of robust strategies for supply reliability.

title: A water security case study for Central Cebu, Philippines
summary: Reassessment of water security under rapid urban growth and salinization using CRIDA.
context: Increasing demand and saltwater intrusion threaten water supply.
actions: Hydrological modelling and stress testing under demand/climate uncertainty.
outcomes: Improved adaptive planning compared to traditional IWRM.

title: Nature-Based Solutions to Adapt to Climate Change and Rapid Urbanization
summary: Development of green infrastructure strategies to address urban flooding and climate risks.
actions: Stakeholder co-design and evaluation of green infrastructure.

title: Incorporating Climate Change into Colombia’s Hydropower Planning
summary: Assessment of hydropower resilience under climate uncertainty using CRIDA.
context: Hydropower system exposed to drought variability.
actions: Bottom-up risk analysis and stress testing.

title: Using Nature-Based Solutions for Flood Resilience
summary: Urban flood resilience planning using nature-based solutions and modelling.
context: Urban flooding exacerbated by climate change and sea-level rise.
actions: Flood modelling and evaluation of green infrastructure.

title: Seasonal limitations of freshwater availability in Ntoum, Gabon
summary: Assessment of water supply reliability under climate change and population growth.
context: Demand growth is a key driver of risk.

title: Assessment of climate risks on water resources for NAP for Bhutan
summary: Climate risk assessment for water resources within Bhutan’s national adaptation planning.
context: Climate impacts on hydrology and hydropower.
actions: Risk and vulnerability assessment aligned with CRIDA principles.

title: CRIDA for the Atuel River basin, Argentina
summary: Ongoing project addressing water scarcity and climate impacts in the Atuel basin.

title: The creation of the Great Lakes Adaptive Management (GLAM) committee
summary: Creation of a governance structure to manage water levels under uncertainty.
context: Need for adaptive management in transboundary systems.

title: Eco-engineering: Mexico Water Reserves Program
summary: Evaluation of environmental flow allocation as an ecosystem-based adaptation strategy.
context: Water allocation conflicts and ecosystem degradation.
outcomes: Demonstrated co-benefits for biodiversity and resilience.

title: Decision making under climate uncertainty in the Magdalena River basin
summary: Hydropower planning under uncertainty in Colombia.

title: Urban flood resilience strategy
summary: Urban flood modelling and resilience planning.

title: Dynamic Adaptive Policy Pathways for municipal planning
summary: Adaptive pathways approach for planning under uncertainty.

title: Tisza River shared vision planning
